race.description: Book A Christmas Party @ Crjc Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: AYAKA (6) is the one to beat after a strong debut second at this track, beaten just over half a length despite racing wide through the middle stages. She started at long odds there, so the performance had genuine merit, and the soft-track placing at this venue gives her the clearest exposed case. UNIVERSAL ENERGY (3) was only fourth on debut but began awkwardly, was bumped and steadied, yet still finished within just over two lengths of Brief Authority after being near the top of betting. PARTING THE SEAS (5) was beaten two and a half lengths behind Harvey's Turn at this venue and now gets meaningful weight relief, although his 1020m record keeps the case slightly qualified. ENCONTRE (13) improved into third at Ballina at long odds, beaten just under a length, and that gives him enough recent substance to press for a minor upset if he holds that level.
